atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLen = input(50, "Coil Length", 10, 150, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "Vol-of-Vol Length", 5, 60, 1)
predLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 5, 60, 1)
coilThresh = input(0.75, "Coil Threshold", 0.1, 0.95, 0.05)
predThresh = input(0.55, "Predictability Threshold", 0.1, 0.9, 0.05)
releaseMult = input(1.5, "Release Mult", 1.1, 3.0, 0.1)
vovRiseBars = input(3, "VoV Rise Bars", 1, 10, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
R = high - low
highestATR = highest(atrVal, coilLen)
highestR = highest(R, coilLen)
coilATR = atrVal / max(highestATR, 0.0001)
coilRange = R / max(highestR, 0.0001)
load = 1 - (coilATR + coilRange) / 2
vovBase = sma(atrVal, vovLen)
vov = stdev(atrVal, vovLen) / max(vovBase, 0.0001)
vovRising = vov > vov[vovRiseBars]
absCh = abs(close - close[1])
avgAbsCh = sma(absCh, predLen)
sumAbs = avgAbsCh * predLen
moveLen = abs(close - close[predLen])
pred = moveLen / max(sumAbs, 0.0001)
lowestR = lowest(R, coilLen)
rangeExpand = R > releaseMult * lowestR
atrUp = atrVal > atrVal[1]
release = rangeExpand and atrUp
loaded = load > coilThresh
predictable = pred > predThresh
chargedNoFire = loaded and vovRising and pred <= predThresh
buyCond = loaded and vovRising and predictable and release and close > open and close > close[1]
sellCond = loaded and vovRising and predictable and release and close < open and close < close[1]
buySig = buyCond and not buyCond[1]
sellSig = sellCond and not sellCond[1]

if buySig { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if sellSig { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if buySig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Release Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if sellSig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Release Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if chargedNoFire { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Charged", "sphere", "#8a8f98", 0.5 * markerSize, 1, "separate") }
if loaded and predictable and not release { bgcolor("#22cc8822") }
if chargedNoFire { bgcolor("#8a8f9822") }

plot(load, "Coil Load", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(pred, "Tape Predictability", "#ffd43b", 1, "separate")
hline(coilThresh, "#22aaff", "separate")
hline(predThresh, "#ffd43b", "separate")
plot3d(load, "Coil Load Height", "bars3d", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(pred, "Predictability", "ribbon", "#ffd43b", "separate", 1)

sessLen = input(20, "Session Length", 5, 200, 1)
structLook = input(3, "Structure Lookback", 2, 20, 1)
confThresh = input(60, "Confidence Threshold", 0, 100, 1)
hardStopTicks = input(20, "Hard Stop Ticks", 1, 200, 1)

sessHigh = highest(high, sessLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLen)
sessRange = sessHigh - sessLow

htfClose = security("1h", close)
htfHigh = security("1h", high)
htfLow = security("1h", low)

htfSwingHigh = highest(htfHigh, structLook)
htfSwingLow = lowest(htfLow, structLook)

var htfTrend = 0.0
var longEntryPx = 0.0
var shortEntryPx = 0.0
var longStopPx = 0.0
var shortStopPx = 0.0
var inLong = 0.0
var inShort = 0.0

if htfClose > htfSwingHigh[1] {
    htfTrend := 1.0
} else {
    if htfClose < htfSwingLow[1] {
        htfTrend := -1.0
    }
}

isBull = htfTrend == 1.0
isBear = htfTrend == -1.0

brokenLvl = isBull ? htfSwingHigh[1] : htfSwingLow[1]
dispDist = abs(htfClose - brokenLvl)
sessRangeSafe = sessRange + 0.000000001
dispRatio = dispDist / sessRangeSafe
dispScore = dispRatio > 1 ? 25.0 : dispRatio * 25.0
heldBull = htfLow > htfSwingLow[1]
heldBear = htfHigh < htfSwingHigh[1]
heldOK = isBull ? heldBull : heldBear
overlapScore = heldOK ? 25.0 : 0.0
quality = 50.0 + dispScore + overlapScore
confScore = quality / 100.0

longArm = crossover(close, sessHigh[1])
shortArm = crossunder(close, sessLow[1])
confOK = quality >= confThresh
buySig = longArm and isBull and confOK and inLong == 0.0
sellSig = shortArm and isBear and confOK and inShort == 0.0
longExitSig = inLong == 1.0 and (close < sessLow or isBear or low <= longStopPx)
shortExitSig = inShort == 1.0 and (close > sessHigh or isBull or high >= shortStopPx)

if buySig {
    model.confidence(confScore)
    model.stopLoss(hardStopTicks, "abs")
    model.longEntry("siege-long")
    longEntryPx := close
    longStopPx := close - hardStopTicks
    inLong := 1.0
    inShort := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(confScore)
    model.stopLoss(hardStopTicks, "abs")
    model.shortEntry("siege-short")
    shortEntryPx := close
    shortStopPx := close + hardStopTicks
    inShort := 1.0
    inLong := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if longExitSig {
    model.longExit("siege-long")
    inLong := 0.0
    longEntryPx := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Exit", "xcross", "#ffcc00")
}
if shortExitSig {
    model.shortExit("siege-short")
    inShort := 0.0
    shortEntryPx := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Exit", "xcross", "#ffcc00")
}

plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

slowVol = stdev(r, slowLen) * sqrt(slowLen)

wx = input(1.0, "wind_direction_vector_x", -10.0, 10.0, 0.1)
wy = input(0.0, "wind_direction_vector_y", -10.0, 10.0, 0.1)
wz = input(0.0, "wind_direction_vector_z", -10.0, 10.0, 0.1)
windSpeedIn = input(10.0, "wind_speed_knots", 0.0, 100.0, 0.5)
minSpeed = input(0.0, "min_speed_knots", 0.0, 50.0, 0.5)
maxSpeed = input(50.0, "max_speed_knots", 10.0, 100.0, 0.5)
baseTail = input(1.0, "base_tail_length", 0.2, 5.0, 0.1)
lenPerKnot = input(0.1, "length_per_knot", 0.0, 1.0, 0.01)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

drift = (close - open) * 0.2
windSpeed = windSpeedIn + drift
xd = wx + (close - open) * 0.01
yd = wy + (high - low) * 0.01
zd = wz + (close - close[1]) * 0.01

mag = sqrt(xd * xd + yd * yd + zd * zd)
safeMag = mag + 0.0000001
nx = xd / safeMag
ny = yd / safeMag
nz = zd / safeMag

horiz = sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny + 0.0000001)
yawRad = atan2(ny, nx)
pitchRad = atan2(nz, horiz)
yawDegRaw = yawRad * 57.29578
pitchDegRaw = pitchRad * 57.29578
rollDeg = 0.0

var prevYaw = 0.0
var prevPitch = 0.0
isZero = mag < 0.000001
if isZero {
    yawDegRaw := prevYaw
    pitchDegRaw := prevPitch
}
if mag >= 0.000001 {
    prevYaw := yawDegRaw
    prevPitch := yawDegRaw
}
yawDeg = yawDegRaw
pitchDeg = pitchDegRaw

tailLen = baseTail + lenPerKnot * windSpeed
span = maxSpeed - minSpeed + 0.0000001
tRaw = (windSpeed - minSpeed) / span
tHi = min(tRaw, 1.0)
tRatio = max(tHi, 0.0)
rComp = tRatio
gComp = 0.5 * tRatio
bComp = 1.0 - tRatio
arrowSizeRaw = tailLen * 0.4 * markerSize
arrowSizeHi = min(arrowSizeRaw, 3.0)
arrowSize = max(arrowSizeHi, 0.2)

highLevel = maxSpeed * 0.8
calmLevel = minSpeed + 5.0
prevSpeed = windSpeed[1]
prevYawHist = yawDeg[1]
yawDelta = abs(yawDeg - prevYawHist)

highTrig = windSpeed > highLevel and prevSpeed <= highLevel
calmTrig = windSpeed < calmLevel and prevSpeed >= calmLevel
shiftTrig = yawDelta > 30.0 and windSpeed > 15.0
buySig = calmTrig
sellSig = highTrig or shiftTrig

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Calm", "triangleup", "#2266ff")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "HighWind", "triangledown", "#ff8800")
}
if shiftTrig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Shift", "triangledown", "#ff8800")
}
if highTrig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "HighWind", "conedown", "#ff8800", arrowSize, 0, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}
if calmTrig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Calm", "coneup", "#2266ff", arrowSize, 1, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}
if shiftTrig {

}
showArrow = bar_index % 10 == 0
if showArrow {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, close, "WindVec", "coneup", "#ff8800", arrowSize, 1, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}

plot(windSpeed, "Wind Speed kn", "#2266ff", 1, "separate")
plot3d(tailLen, "Wind Tail Length", "bars3d", "#ff8800", "separate", 0)
